description: Create a signed upload URL and media record for shell-capable clients that can PUT raw bytes to the returned Supabase URL (for example Claude Code or a local CLI). Do NOT use this from browser-sandboxed chat clients such as ChatGPT or Claude.ai: their sandboxes block network egress to Supabase storage, so the byte upload will fail. Those clients must use aidelly_upload_media instead (this tool is hidden automatically for known chat clients).

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in. Do not ask the user for this UUID — call aidelly_list_workspaces and use the `id` of the matching workspace. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_create_media_upload_url
